headline.en: Yunnan highland beans, roasted and brewed in-house

traits.zh: 咖啡豆来自云南临沧耿马深山，主理人全程参与种植到烘焙
traits.en: Coffee beans from Lincang Gengma's highlands; roaster oversees planting to roasting

traits.zh: 招牌‘手冲黑美人’，香气四溢、入口绵密、唇齿留香
traits.en: Signature pour-over 'Black Beauty': aromatic, silky mouthfeel, lingering finish

traits.zh: ‘一豆双喝’：同种豆制成美式与拿铁两款
traits.en: 'One Bean, Two Ways': same bean used for both Americano and latte

traits.zh: 纯白两层loft集装箱，二楼设露营空间配露营装备
traits.en: Two-story white loft container with a rooftop camping setup and gear

traits.zh: 限定桂花酒酿系列，非咖啡爱好者也会因咖啡香消费
traits.en: Seasonal osmanthus rice wine series — draws even non-coffee drinkers with coffee aroma

focus.zh: 二楼露营空间非办公导向

linger.zh: 莫奈小花园+露营空间促久坐

adventure.zh: 自烘SOE、手冲黑美人、一豆双喝、桂花酒酿系列
adventure.en: In-house SOE, signature pour-over, one-bean dual brew, seasonal fermented drinks
